build_roi_mask_head: build a ROIMaskHead module from config and input channels for mask prediction in Mask R-CNN
forward_roi_mask_head: run the ROIMaskHead forward pass with features and proposals to compute mask logits and losses
keep_only_positive_boxes: filter a list of BoxList objects to keep only boxes with labels greater than zero
review_roi_mask_head_forward: review the ROIMaskHead forward method to understand training vs inference branching logic for mask prediction
refactor_keep_only_positive_boxes: refactor keep_only_positive_boxes to support additional filtering criteria beyond positive labels
